what: the corpus lane's list of the read words at the 28 places written one way and read another whose read form holds two or three words: for each of the 57 read words, its main tag as TAHOT writes it and its pieces as TAHOT gives them; and beside it the lane's two facts for the stroke at each of the 16 places of relay v179. Kept here byte for byte in the folder the lane keeps them in, with their rule, their receipt and their counts. tools/apply-read-words-v1.mjs writes each read word's tag on its own region of the zone and, at the places the lattice gives no pieces, the pieces; the reader asks each read word its own entry and draws the place's line from the pieces. The stroke facts write nothing: they are held equal to the list data/paseq-place/PIN.json names, which the zones already carry

pieces_held.why: read word 1's piece carries TAHOT's spelling, with a yod the edition's read word does not write (the line says how_found SPELLING_ASIDE), so the place's pieces do not spell its read words and the reader could not lay them under the read form: they are put back to the corpus lane (put-back 35 of the landing plan of 14 November 2026). Its two tags are held with them (the page lane's call of 15 November 2026): with the tags landed and the pieces held, the line at rest would print «common + broken», a reading read word 1's own card then withholds (asked H2428A, its block withholds every row that prints «common», each of H2455). So the place is held whole: no tag and no piece is written there, and its card and its line stay as they are live
pieces_held.until: put-back 35 lands: the lane reissues the line with the edition's letters, or says how the piece is carried. Then the place's tags land with its pieces

lifted_by: the lane's next lattice, which carries each read word's pieces and tags on the read-form entry itself (RULE.md, section 8). The tool refuses a zone projected from another lattice than the one the lane's receipt read, and this pin is retired then
note: every sha256 here is the one the relay's letter names for the file, and the lane's receipt names the two lists, the counts and the rule by the same. The lane's folder also holds its builder, its second count and that count's receipt; the second count found the 28 places from the lattice's surfaces alone and agreed on all 57 lines and all 16 stroke lines. Those files are not kept here. Which places are held back, and what of each (its pieces, or, where the entry holds «tags and pieces», the place whole), is the page lane's decision, set here as data so neither the tool nor the check names a place in its code: at a place held whole the tool writes no tag and no piece and refuses a zone that carries either, and the check holds the place to carry neither. The readings named here are the two the landing plan of 14 November 2026 names for this list (its section 4.2), each written as the list gives the read word's pieces, a slash between them: the tool refuses a pin that names a reading the list does not give, and the check holds the page's line to each, so no check names a place in its code either
